context: A police officer briefs a manager about a court case
purpose: Teach: 被疑/面会/先送り/白紙/水質/非公式/たたき台/商事

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社の被疑事案、現在、捜査中です。
lines.en: Your company's case is currently under investigation.
lines.style: Professional, measured opening. Level gaze. No inflection — fact delivered as fact. The kind of statement that needs no softening because the tone itself is steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。担当者との面会、調整しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've arranged a meeting with our contact person.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Not defensive. Slight nod of acknowledgment. Clear, cooperative tone — showing willingness without overselling.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 判決の先送りは、好ましくありません。
lines.en: Delaying the verdict would not be advisable.
lines.style: Direct, procedural statement. Slight weight on the advisory. Not a threat — an observation stated with quiet authority. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。白紙撤回せず、慎重に対応します。
lines.en: Understood. We won't withdraw our position, but we'll proceed carefully.
lines.style: Measured affirmation. Slight emphasis on 'carefully' — showing thoughtfulness, not stalling. Steady, responsible tone. The voice of someone taking this seriously.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 工場の水質、再検査もご検討ください。
lines.en: I'd also recommend reconsidering a retest of the plant's water quality.
lines.style: Procedural suggestion, not mandate. Slight pause before 'also' — showing this is an addition worth considering. Steady, professional tone. Practical weight, not pressure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 非公式な確認も、進めています。
lines.en: We're already moving forward with informal verification as well.
lines.style: Proactive, reassuring. Shows initiative without grandstanding. 'Already' lands with quiet competence. Clear and calm — demonstrating progress and diligence.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: たたき台、来週共有します。
lines.en: I'll share a draft proposal with you next week.
lines.style: Clear commitment, matter-of-fact. No flourish. The tone of someone whose word is understood to be solid. Practical, forward-looking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 親会社の三井商事、巻き込んで対応します。
lines.en: We're looping in the parent company, Mitsui Shoji, to handle this coordinated response.
lines.style: Final statement, assured and comprehensive. Slight emphasis on 'coordinated' — showing the scope and seriousness. Calm closure. The tone of someone who has thought this through.
